---
title: "DNAm_RNA_deconvolution_comparisons"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(glue)
library(readxl)
library(magrittr)

project_dir <- "~/Documents/repos/explant-seq"
dna_m_path <- glue("{project_dir}/data/DNA/DNA-methylation/2026-06-19/HiBED_deconvolution_260810.csv")
rna_path <- glue("{project_dir}/data/RNA/cibersort_res_job11_260609.csv")

dna_m <- read.csv(dna_m_path)
rna <- read.csv(rna_path)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- dna_m: reshape to long, already in percent (0-100) ---
dna_long <- dna_m %>%
  select(Sample_Name, Endothelial, Stromal, Astrocyte, Microglial,
         Oligodendrocyte, GABA, GLU) %>%
  rename(GABA_Inhibitory = GABA, GLU_Excitatory = GLU) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Sample_Name,
    names_to = "cell_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dataset = "DNAm", sample_id = Sample_Name) %>%
  select(sample_id, dataset, cell_type, proportion)

# --- rna: reshape to long, convert fraction -> percent, drop Opc ---
rna_long <- rna %>%
  select(Mixture, Ex, Oli, In, Mic, Ast, End, Per) %>%  # Opc dropped
  rename(
    GLU_Excitatory   = Ex,
    Oligodendrocyte  = Oli,
    GABA_Inhibitory  = In,
    Microglial       = Mic,
    Astrocyte        = Ast,
    Endothelial      = End,
    Stromal          = Per
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Mixture,
    names_to = "cell_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = proportion * 100,   # fraction -> percent
    dataset = "RNA",
    sample_id = Mixture
  ) %>%
  select(sample_id, dataset, cell_type, proportion)

# --- combine ---
combined <- bind_rows(dna_long, rna_long) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = c(
    "Microglial", "Oligodendrocyte", "Astrocyte",
    "Endothelial", "Stromal", "GABA_Inhibitory", "GLU_Excitatory"
  )))
```

```{r}
cell_type_colors <- c(
  "GLU_Excitatory"  = "#3B9AB2", 
  "Oligodendrocyte" = "#7EB6BC",
  "GABA_Inhibitory" = "#A2C0A5",
  "Microglial"      = "#C6C872",
  "Astrocyte"       = "#E79308",
  "Endothelial"     = "#ED6703",
  "Stromal"         = "#F22200"
)



ggplot(combined, aes(x = cell_type, y = proportion,
                      fill = cell_type,
                      group = interaction(cell_type, dataset))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = dataset),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
             color = "black", size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_type_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("DNAm" = 16, "RNA" = 17)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion (%)", shape = "Dataset", fill = "Cell type")
```
